name: Contractor Foreman
summary: Construction management — estimating, scheduling, daily logs and financial tracking — priced per company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier.
best_for: small and mid-size contractors who want estimating, scheduling and daily logs in one place and can commit to a year — the company-wide fee makes it cheap per head once you have a crew
skip_if: you are a sole trader with a handful of jobs, because Basic at $49 a month annual is real money against a spreadsheet and a calendar — though the 30-day trial and the conditional 100-day refund mean trying it costs nothing but your time
honest_knock: Credit where it is due first: this is company pricing with unlimited projects and no per-user overage inside your tier, which is rare in construction software and genuinely cheaper than per-seat rivals for a crew. The catch is the billing term. Quarterly costs 26% more than annual on the same plan — $132 against $105 on Standard — and Basic is not sold quarterly at all, so the cheapest way in requires a year paid up front. The user counts are the real ladder: 1, 3, 8, 15, unlimited. A five-person crew is not on Standard at $105, it is on Plus at $166, so count your licence holders before you compare against anything else.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed annually for the whole company with 1 user
pricing.notes: (re-verified 28 Aug 2026 on their own pricing page; all plan prices unchanged since 1 Aug 2026) Priced for the company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier, and every plan opens with 30 days free before the first bill. Annual: Basic $49/month ($588 a year, 1 user), Standard $105 ($1,264, 3 users), Plus $166 ($1,997, 8 users), Pro $221 ($2,654, 15 users), Unlimited $332 ($3,984, unlimited users). Quarterly costs more for the same plans: Standard $132/month ($395 a quarter), Plus $206 ($619), Pro $282 ($845), Unlimited $415 ($1,245). Basic is not offered quarterly. Their own wording: the fee listed is the fee for the company as a whole. Card payments taken through the built-in Stripe integration are billed separately at 2.9% + $0.30 a transaction (3.9% + $0.30 for Amex, 1% + $0.30 capped at $10.00 for ACH).
